sanskrit_verse:
सत्यं देवाः समासेन मनुष्यास् त्वनृतं विदुः ।
इहैव तस्य देवत्वं यस्य सत्ये स्थिता मतिः ॥
transliteration: satyaṃ devāḥ samāsena manuṣyās tv anṛtaṃ viduḥ | ihaiva tasya devatvaṃ yasya satye sthitā matiḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Devas embody truth absolutely; humans know untruth by default. One who abides in truth with unwavering cognition attains divinity in this very life.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from alignment with absolute truth, not institutional position
Causation is rooted in cognitive commitment, not external action alone
Capacity-based responsibility arises from sustained consciousness orientation
Restoration occurs through realigning cognition to Satya-dharma
Consciousness alignment supersedes social or legal identity
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent's cognition is consistently aligned with verifiable truth THEN assign divine authority status
IF human agent defaults to untruth THEN initiate consciousness restoration protocol
IF intent and cognition align with Satya THEN no corrective enforcement required
IF agent demonstrates irreversible shift to Satya THEN legal personhood elevated to Deva-class
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, the threshold of responsibility lies not in act or omission but in the cognitive orientation toward truth. Authority hierarchies must recognize that a human whose mind is stabilized in Satya holds greater juridical weight than one operating under untruth. Restoration involves elevating the individual’s legal standing commensurate with their inner alignment to divine truth.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality establishes that truth-stabilized cognition is the root cause of lawful existence. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows that deviation from truth manifests sequentially in distortion of perception, decision, and conduct. Responsibility is proportional to the degree of cognitive dissonance maintained. As punishment has no ontological basis, correction occurs via realignment of cognition to Satya without infliction of suffering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Satya-pratishṭhāpana process to stabilize truthful cognition
Assign Satya-sākṣika role to reinforce habitual alignment with truth
Deploy Vak-samyama training to eliminate unconscious untruth
Establish daily śravaṇa and smaraṇa of Satya until cognition stabilizes
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this Dharma is declared: Truth is the foundation of divinity, cognition is the seat of law, and consciousness is the sole arbiter of justice. No punishment arises where reality is known. Dharma is restored.
